verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Fenwick represents VC-backed companies, which is the company side of the table. For investors, its Venture Capital Services only offers introductions to clients raising capital. That is an adjacent deal-flow service, not legal representation of venture funds or investors, so it gives no evidence of market-term knowledge from the investor side.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm also represents venture funds and investors, so it knows current market terms from both sides of the table

citations.quote: For investors, VCS facilitates intelligent introductions to clients raising venture capital.
